description:
Commits the case file and the queue line of the batch decoder's profile series, without running it.

## Background

The profile of `dev/active/3be770d5` attributes the single-frame decoder's time to categories by source span and records counter groups at one, six, twelve and twenty-four workers. Its series runs a profiling executable under a session script, each session under its own host acquisition, and its summarizer resolves each sample to a category. The lane route widens the decoder workspace eightfold per worker, so cache traffic is the limit the counters test. The story has a profiling executable of the LDPC batch decoder and a series launcher for it under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/`. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A case file names record cases of the lane route and the single-frame route at one and twenty-four workers, and stat cases of both at one, six, twelve and twenty-four workers, on both recorded codes.
- [hard] REQ-02: An untimed dry session over one case shows the control channel and the record path work.
- [hard] REQ-03: One line for the series is committed in `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv` with its estimated minutes.
title: Prepare the profile series of the batch decoder
